newsitem.title: NORWAY: Perry says NATO to invite new members in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Perry says NATO to invite new members in 1997.

text.p: U.S. Secretary of Defence William Perry said on Thursday several countries would be invited to join NATO at a special summit in 1997.
"At a summit next year several countries will be invited to start accession talks," he told reporters.
Perry declined to be drawn on which countries may be invited to join the alliance, but emphasised the process would be going ahead despite the opposition of Russia.
Since the end of the Cold War, ex-Communist countries such as Poland have been seeking to join NATO to guarantee their future security against Russia.

"Let me say, if I thought it was in any way threatening to Russia I would not support it," he said. Perry said he would be discussing the issue later on Thursday with Russian Defence Minister Igor Rodionov.

"Our goal is not to threaten Russia but to bring Russia into the European security circle," he added, saying he wanted to build on the landmark cooperation between NATO and Russia in the current peace mission in Bosnia.
